summary: pcfile.dbs on-disk character record layout. 24-byte file header + 16 × 432-byte records. The on-disk record is identical to the in-memory layout (confirmed via straight rep-movsw memcpy in wbase.ovr's add_party_member handler). The wpcvw-naming-pass.json bss_layout had several wrong offsets in the first 0x30 bytes of the record; this pass corrects them with empirical evidence.

fields.note: 432 bytes per record, matching the in-memory character slot stride
16 slots maximum
24 bytes; records start immediately after
Per-slot: 0=empty, 1=available (not in party), 2=in party. Stock file has first 6 bytes = 1, rest 0.

load_path.description: How pcfile.dbs records reach in-memory character slots

function_read_char.description: read_char_from_pcfile — called with args (char_index, dst_buf, mode=0). Seeks to header_size + char_index * record_size, then reads exactly record_size (0x1b0) bytes into dst_buf. Straight file read, no field translation.

key_instructions: 25af: mov di, 0x43e8 + slot*0x1b0  ; destination = BSS char slot
function_add_party_member.conclusion: The disk buffer is memcpy'd verbatim into the BSS slot. ON-DISK LAYOUT == IN-MEMORY LAYOUT.

record_layout.note: Slot N at file offset 0x18 + N*0x1b0; in-memory at BSS 0x43e8 + N*0x1b0

fields.note: ASCIIZ name, 7 chars max + null terminator. NOT 12 bytes as wpcvw bss_layout claimed.

evidence.details: TEMPEST fills 7 chars + null in bytes 0..7; XP starts at +0x08 (verified). Max observed name length = 7 (TEMPEST, LYSANDR). The bss_layout claiming char[12] is wrong — that would put XP at +0x0c, but we see XP = 6590 at +0x08 and 0 at +0x0c.

fields.note: Experience points. NOT at +0x0c as wpcvw bss_layout claimed.

evidence.details: Values 6590/7405/7265/7057/6603/6698 are specific, distinct, plausible Wiz6 XP amounts. +0x0c is 0 for all 6 stock chars.

fields.note: All zeros for all 6 stock characters. May be gold_u32 + padding, or reserved fields. wpcvw bss_layout claimed xp_low+xp_high at +0x0c/+0x0e and gold at +0x14/+0x16 — those are incorrect based on empirical evidence; the actual content here is unknown.
Current character level (1-based). NOT at +0x24 as wpcvw bss_layout claimed (which was wrong). The bss_layout had 'hp_cur' at this offset — empirically that's wrong.

evidence.details: Values 8/9/5/4/4/2 match the pre-discovered facts exactly. Distinct plausible levels for stock chars.

fields.note: Always equals level in stock data. Likely max_level (for class-change throttle) or saved_old_level. wpcvw bss_layout called this 'hp_max' — incorrect.
Current hit points. wpcvw bss_layout had this at +0x18 (wrong) and called it 'hp_cur'. Empirically, HP is here at +0x1c.

evidence.details: Fully-varying column, values 75-126 are plausible HP for levels 2-9.

fields.note: Maximum hit points. Equals hp_cur for stock chars (fully healed). wpcvw bss_layout had this at +0x1a (wrong).
Spirit points (mana), current pool. Values 128-295 are plausible for mid-level chars. Fighters (THESUS, TEMPEST) have highest SP which is unexpected — may be combined/total pool.

Gold pieces. Values 1035-2700 are plausible starting amounts for stock characters. May be low word of a u32 with the high word at +0x24 (constant=1), but +0x24=1 seems more likely to be a different field.

Constant 01 00 01 00 across all 6 stock chars. wpcvw bss_layout claimed 'level' at +0x24 (abs 0x440c) — that is wrong; the actual level is at +0x18. This field may be 'initialized flag', 'base_level_1', or stock-char-creation metadata.
6 school × (cur+max) u16 pairs = 24 bytes. Mostly zero for fighters; partial values for NOBAL (Priest) and TREON/PENTAG (Ninja). Could be per-school mana allocation rather than sp_cur/sp_max totals.
fields.values_note: NOBAL: school[4]=(5,5), school[5]=(4,4). TREON: school[0]=(3,3), school[4]=(3,3). PENTAG: school[1]=(3,3), school[3]=(3,3).

fields.note: 22 item slots, 8 bytes each. Layout per item: +0 item_id u16, +2 u16 (field2), +4 u8 (type?), +5 u8 (flags?), +6 u8, +7 u8. Matches wpcvw bss_layout. Stock chars have 5 non-zero items each.

evidence.details: Item 0 IDs: THESUS=8, TEMPEST=8 (same weapon class), LYSANDR=6, NOBAL=24, TREON=18, PENTAG=18. Each pair sharing the same items supports consistent stock character setup.

fields.note: 8 equipment slots, each holding inventory-index of equipped item. 0xFF = empty. All stock chars have all 0xFF (nothing equipped on load from pcfile). Matches wpcvw bss_layout.
fields.values: ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff (all 6 stock chars)

fields.note: Range +0x118..+0x121. Contains values like [1,1,0,0,0,0,...] at +0x120/+0x121. Possibly conditions[10] per wpcvw bss_layout (which claimed +0x122) — off by 2 bytes, or this is a different field.

10-condition tracker per wpcvw bss_layout. Values at +0x120/+0x121 are [1,1,1,2,2,2] / [1,1,1,3,3,3] which could be level-tier conditions or bitmaps. The exact condition byte mapping needs verification.

STR/INT/PIE/VIT/DEX/SPD in that order. Matches wpcvw bss_layout. THESUS (Fighter) has STR=18, LYSANDR (Mage) has high DEX/SPD (14/12), NOBAL (Priest type) has high PIE=13. All values in plausible 6-18 range.
14 skill levels (0..100). Matches wpcvw bss_layout. Values are low (0-16) which is plausible for mid-level characters.
Range +0x142..+0x19b. Contains spell known/available bitmaps and per-school progress. Not decoded in this pass; partially-varying bytes suggest school-specific data.
Count of items in inventory (0..22). Matches actual non-zero item count in inventory_records.

evidence.details: All 6 stock chars have +0x1ac=5, which exactly matches counting non-zero item IDs in +0x40..+0xef. wpcvw bss_layout claims abs 0x4594=inventory_count which = slot0+0x1ac — this one is CORRECT.

fields.note: Range +0x1a0..+0x1aa. wpcvw bss_layout says sex at +0x1a0 (abs 0x4589), selected_weapon_hand at +0x1a2/+0x1a3, spells_to_learn at +0x1a8, magic_power at +0x1a9/+0x1aa. These claims need DOSBox verification to confirm. magic_power_hi at +0x1ab (abs 0x4593) has distinct values [10,8,13,10,9,7] — plausible.

Range +0x19c..+0x1a3. wpcvw bss_layout claims: race at +0x19c (abs 0x4585), class at +0x19e (abs 0x4587), high_water_level at +0x19f (abs 0x4588). The values at +0x19c are [0,22,20,3,8,18] — NOT plausible race indices (too high for 10-race system). The values at +0x19f are [0,0,3,2,1,1] which ARE plausible race indices (Human=0, Elf=1, Dwarf=2, Gnome=3). wpcvw bss_layout likely has a 1-byte offset error in this region. Best guess: race at +0x19f, class somewhere nearby, but unconfirmed without DOSBox.

Range +0x1ad..+0x1af. wpcvw bss_layout says: equipped_count at +0x1ad, ac_extra_byte at +0x1ae, saved_old_level at +0x1af. All three are 0/100/0 in constant rows. +0x1ae=100 for all stocks could be starting AC value (100 = default before adjustment?). Not verified.

discrepancy_with_in_memory_layout.conclusion: SAME LAYOUT (direct memcpy confirmed), but wpcvw-naming-pass.json bss_layout has wrong offsets for several early fields.
discrepancy_with_in_memory_layout.root_cause: The wpcvw subagent's bss_layout analysis incorrectly claimed name=char[12] (actual: char[8]). This shifted XP from +0x08 to claimed +0x0c, then caused a chain of misidentifications for hp/level in the +0x18..+0x27 region. Fields from +0x12c onward (attributes, skills, inventory) appear correct in the bss_layout.

specific_corrections.evidence: +0x19c values [0,22,20,3,8,18] out of race-index range; +0x19f values [0,0,3,2,1,1] look like race indices

unmapped_regions.note: All 0 in stock data. Could be gold u32 + padding, or reserved fields.
Per-school SP pairs or similar. Mostly 0 for fighters, small values for priest/ninja.
Conditions + surrounding bytes. wpcvw claims +0x122..+0x12b = conditions[10], but the actual byte content suggests off-by-a-few alignment.
After SPD, before skill_levels. Constant or near-constant.
Spell bitmaps, school data, assorted flags. Large TBD region.
Race/class/sex/alignment region. wpcvw offsets may be off by 1-3 bytes. DOSBox verification needed.
Tail fields (equipped_count, ac_extra, saved_old_level per wpcvw). Near-constant in stock data.

unresolved: Gold field exact offset: +0x22 as u16 is medium-confidence; the region +0x0c..+0x17 is all-zeros and might hold a u32 gold that's not exercised in stock chars.
Race offset exact byte: wpcvw claims +0x19c, empirical suggests +0x19f. Neither is definitively confirmed — stock chars may have very specific race values that alias with non-race data.
Class byte location: could be in the +0x19c..+0x1a3 region but exact byte unconfirmed without DOSBox live-read verification.
Sex byte: wpcvw claims +0x1a0 (abs 0x4589), all stock chars show 0 there — either 0=male in Wiz6, or the field is at a different offset.
+0x1a: level_dup vs max_level vs secondary_class_level — same as level for stock chars, can't distinguish without a char that has undergone class change.
sp_cur at +0x20: fighter THESUS has 295 SP which seems high — may be a different stat (total_mana_pool vs per-school distribution at +0x28).

findings.claim: pcfile.dbs has a 24-byte header: record_size(u16), slot_count(u16), header_size(u32), status[16](u8 each)

evidence.details: First 24 bytes: b0 01 10 00 18 00 00 00 01 01 01 01 01 01 00 ... File size = 24 + 16*432 = 6936 bytes, matches actual file size exactly.

findings.claim: Record data is read from disk verbatim into the BSS character slot with no field-by-field translation. On-disk layout == in-memory layout.

evidence.details: rep movsw at 0x25b8 with cx=0xd8=216 words=432 bytes copies from stack buffer (loaded by read_char_from_pcfile at 0x0036) to BSS slot 0x43e8+N*0x1b0. No intermediate translation.

findings.claim: Name field is 8 bytes (7 chars max + null), not 12 bytes as the wpcvw bss_layout claimed.

evidence.details: TEMPEST fills bytes 0..7 exactly (7 chars + null). XP = 6590 at +0x08 (u32le). If name were 12 bytes, XP would start at +0x0c, but +0x0c is 0 for all chars.

findings.claim: XP is at on-disk/in-memory +0x08 (u32le), not at +0x0c as wpcvw bss_layout claimed.

evidence.details: THESUS: bytes 8..11 = BE 19 00 00 = 6590 decimal = plausible XP for level-8 character. Bytes 12..15 = 00 00 00 00.

findings.claim: Level is at +0x18 (u16le), not at +0x24 as wpcvw bss_layout claimed.

evidence.details: Values at +0x18: [8,9,5,4,4,2] match exactly the expected levels for the stock 6 characters. Values at +0x24 are all 1 — NOT level values.

findings.claim: hp_cur is at +0x1c (u16le), not at +0x18 as wpcvw bss_layout claimed.

evidence.details: Fully-varying column at +0x1c with values 75-126 (plausible HP). The column at +0x18 holds level values 2-9, not HP.

findings.claim: wpcvw bss_layout attributes at +0x12c (STR,INT,PIE,VIT,DEX,SPD) are CORRECT.

evidence.details: THESUS STR=18 (max), LYSANDR DEX=14/SPD=12 (mage-appropriate), NOBAL PIE=13 (priest-appropriate). Values 6-18 across all chars = plausible Wiz6 attribute range.

findings.claim: wpcvw bss_layout inventory_count at +0x1ac (abs 0x4594) is CORRECT; value 5 matches actual item count.

evidence.details: Counting non-zero item IDs in +0x40..+0xef gives exactly 5 for all 6 stock chars. +0x1ac = 5 for all. Match is exact.
